description: ogc.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. The listing groups 53 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plan de prévention des risques PPRN mouvement de terrain du PNR Brenne; Plan de Prévention des Risques Naturels de mouvement de terrain - Zone; District de Reims - Cavités souterraines; Enjeu ponctuel du PPRN mouvements de terrain de la vallée du Clain dép. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
